profile.headline: Software Engineer at American Express GBT
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: I have a strong foundation in software development fundamentals and driven by constant curiosity. I feel the happiest when I am in the "unknown"; where I can find new challenges that test my creativity and problem-solving skills.

positions.title: Software Engineer, The OvationNetwork
positions.description:
• 2025 GBT Pacesetter Award Recipient – Recognized among the top 3% of high performers for exceptional contributions and achievements
• Develop an internal CRM tool to enhance support team efficiency at OvationNetwork, enabling quick access to critical mid and back-office data. Integrated Sabre and Smartsheet APIs, incorporated role-based access control for secure data access, and improved internal team's real-time operational visibility
• Provide technical support during a transition of commission reconciliation process from Unit4 ERP (Agresso) to SION commission tracking software
• Manage one IT Support Specialist as my direct report: weekly one-on-one meetings, daily morning syncs and assigning curated projects that evoke growth in technical knowledge of travel management operations

positions.title: IT Specialist, The OvationNetwork
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Played a pivotal role in resolving a critical, organization-wide issue during a migration to a commission payment workflow with Onyx. Leveraged software development background to understand Agresso accounting software and analyze new commission data formats, to effectively facilitate a successful migration and re-enable payments to clients amidst urgent deadlines. This initiative significantly reduced the time to process commission reconciliation, enhancing OvationNetwork’s value proposition for independent advisors
• Led the development of internal accounting file conversion solutions, collaborating with Ovation’s accounting department to build Node.js programs that standardize and convert commission payment files from consolidators/suppliers (e.g., TACS, Paymode, hotels) - which reduced reliance on third-party services, improving efficiency and cost savings
• Provided ad hoc technical support to OvationNetwork Independent Advisors by remote-connecting to users' PCs to troubleshoot software issues and offer technical guidance

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Utilized the Svelte.js framework’s efficient state management and dynamic reactivity to develop a fluid and interactive drag-and-drop interface
• Implemented CI / CD with GitHub Actions and Travis CI to improve codebase integrity and by automating unit and end-to-end test coverage using Vitest, Svelte Testing Library and Cypress to ensure application functionality before pushing to production
•Leveraged TypeScript to presume static types and interfaces to prevent type coercion and increase debugging efficiency to improve development experience and codebase maintainability
•Migrated website hosting service from AWS to Vercel due to better compatibility and maintainability of the tech stack used in version 2.0 release
positions.insights: Svelte.js, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +5 skills

positions.title: Private Home Health Aide
positions.description:
Provided direct, long-term support for geriatrics and postoperative rehabilitation to private clients

• Maintained constant readiness and leveraged quick thinking in handling emergency situations, ensuring the well-being and safety of clients by promptly responding to medical emergencies and providing appropriate care until medical assistance arrived
• Demonstrated exceptional adaptability and mindfulness in providing compassionate care to a diverse patient population, effectively addressing the unique needs of each client with precision and sensitivity
• Extended emotional support and morale boost in effort to promote a positive environment, address symptoms of depression, and maintain quality of life
Responsibilities varied day-to-day, which included but were not limited to assisting in activities of daily living, maintaining routine schedules, managing appointments, and ensuring dietary and/or exercise requirements are fulfilled

projects.title: Queue-0.com
projects.description: Travel operations CRM for leisure host agencies and their independent advisors, powered by Sabre GDS (ENS + robotic EPR calling SOAP/REST APIs). Future development roadmap scope will include integrating Unit4 ERP (Agresso) APIs into the tech stack for financial data and become the all-in-one CRM platform covering front, mid and back office.

projects.title: bitepay.ai
projects.description: App that helps friends split the dining bill in the fairest manner - with the help of AI!
